rule: Stratify by (domain, language); within a stratum order by task_id and assign alternately from a stratum-specific offset derived from the seed. Target ~60% dev. Deterministic: re-running reproduces it exactly.
note: HOLDOUT IS NOT TO BE MEASURED during development, including by the pilot. It exists so the final H1 evaluation has data the harness was never tuned against. Spending it early cannot be undone.
subdivision_rule: DEV_PILOT is exactly the set already exposed experimentally: the 10 tasks run in ENG-015 and judged in ENG-016. DEV_CLEAN is the remaining 20 DEV tasks, never used in an H1 comparison. No task id was exchanged and no 'better' task was substituted -- membership follows only from what has already been seen.
dev_pilot_policy: DEV_PILOT may still be used for harness debugging, provider calibration, noise measurement and capacity calibration. It must NOT enter the clean DEV H1 result. Roughly a quarter of its human packets were reviewed in ENG-015 with the arm visible, and later blinding cannot undo that.
dev_clean_policy: The clean DEV H1 comparison set. No model call, no human judgement, no prompt inspection for tuning has touched it.
